title: The Shady Woodland
visible: Tall thin trees with bright green leaves
Long fallen log on the forest floor
assumptions: There might be tiny insects hiding under leaves
The log might be soft and home to fungi
Small mammals might visit to nibble plants
The soil is probably damp and shady
Three animal groups and habitat objects are chosen for this teaching game.
landscape: Shady woodland floor with leaf litter and low green cover, tall slender tree trunks, and one long fallen hollow log

inhabitants.name: Woodland Ivy
inhabitants.look: Bright green heart-shaped leaves forming a low carpet and climbing stems

inhabitants.name: Wood Mouse
inhabitants.look: Small brown furry mouse with big ears and long tail

inhabitants.name: Woodland Owl
inhabitants.look: Small brown speckled owl with wide round eyes

inhabitants.name: Woodland Fox
inhabitants.look: Red fox with dark paws and a cream tail tip

events.title: What if it rains less?
events.why: Less rain means less water for growing food.

events.title: What if a warm spell lasts?
events.why: In our teaching rules, warmth uses more water.

events.title: What if another Wood Mouse joins?
events.why: More plant-eaters share the same food.
